functions.name: parse_robinhood_log
functions.docstring:
Parses an unstructured, copy-pasted trade log from the Robinhood web UI.
This now parses both Open and Close trades to enable P/L calculation.

Args:
    file_path (str): The path to the text file containing the trade history.
    year (int): The current year, to correctly parse dates like "Aug 1".

Returns:
    A list of dictionaries, where each dictionary represents a parsed trade.

functions.name: calculate_profit_loss
functions.docstring:
Calculates realized profit and loss from a list of trades using FIFO logic.

Args:
    trades (list): A list of trade dictionaries parsed from the log.

Returns:
    A pandas DataFrame of realized P/L for each completed trade cycle.
